name: Insight Timer
one_liner: Insight Timer offers the world's largest free library of guided meditations, with over 200,000 tracks covering sleep, anxiety, stress, and trauma-informed mindfulness practices.
best_for: People wanting a huge variety of free meditation content
Those who like trying different meditation teachers and styles
People on a budget who can't afford subscription meditation apps
Those interested in trauma-informed mindfulness practices
People who enjoy meditation communities and live events
not_for: Those preferring curated, structured meditation programs (try Headspace)
People who find too many choices overwhelming
Those wanting a simple timer without guided content
short_description: Largest free meditation library with 200K+ guided meditations, sleep music, and trauma-informed mindfulness.
long_description: Insight Timer is a free meditation app with the world's largest library of guided meditations. The app includes over 200,000 tracks from thousands of teachers covering topics from sleep and anxiety to trauma recovery and spiritual practices. Most content is free, with a premium option for courses. The app includes community features, live meditation events, and a meditation timer for unguided practice.
patient_summary: Insight Timer is like a library of guided meditations. Find meditations for sleep, anxiety, trauma, or anything else you're working on. Most content is free, and there are thousands of teachers to explore.

pricing.notes: Most content is free. Premium adds courses, offline access, and advanced features.

privacy.notes: Account required. Free tier is ad-supported. Privacy practices standard for wellness apps.

seo.title: Insight Timer: Free Meditation Library | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Insight Timer offers 200K+ free guided meditations for sleep, anxiety, stress, and trauma. 4.8★, 800K reviews. The world's largest meditation library.

faqs.a: Yes. The vast majority of Insight Timer content (200,000+ meditations) is free. Premium adds structured courses, offline downloads, and removes ads, but you can use the app extensively without paying.

faqs.q: How is Insight Timer different from Calm or Headspace?
faqs.a: Insight Timer has a much larger, more varied library because it's created by thousands of teachers. Calm and Headspace are more curated with structured programs. Insight Timer is better for variety and budget, Calm/Headspace for guided programs.

faqs.q: Does Insight Timer have trauma-informed meditations?
faqs.a: Yes. Insight Timer includes many trauma-informed meditations and teachers who specialize in trauma-sensitive mindfulness. Search 'trauma' to find relevant content. Always practice within your window of tolerance.

faqs.q: Can I use Insight Timer for sleep?
faqs.a: Yes. Insight Timer has thousands of sleep meditations, sleep stories, sleep music, and soundscapes. It's one of the most popular uses of the app.
